messages:
maria: Thanks for coming to today's all-hands. Filing a quick follow-up thread for action items, links, and any lingering questions. Recording + slides: https://redwood-internal.company/all-hands/apr-2026-slides and https://zoom.company/rec/ghijkl

sam: Quick note on the roadmap bullets 1026: the 'cost-optimization' line refers to Redwood Optimize pilot expansions (not a platform-wide price change). Will post clarifying text for external comms.

olivia: Can you confirm who owns the Optimize pilot outreach? I have a few customers interested in participating.

sam: Owner is @olivia + Growth. Will follow up with mailing list and intake form by Wed.

lee: Dedicated update: rollout plan for GA still on track. Beta cohort onboarding next Tue. I'll share the beta checklist in this thread when ready.

anish: Asked during Q&A: any plan to support on-prem GPU variants (A100/3090) in Private? Roadmap?

lee: Short answer: yes, long answer: priority is validated configs for partner hardware (A100/80GB), community-tested profiles for consumer GPUs follow. Adding note to RFC.

kevin: Sales asked for a one-page SLA + feature matrix to share with prospects. Where should they pull the latest vetted copy?

devex-bot: Internal SLA + matrix drafts: https://confluence.company/docs/sla-matrix-draft (internal). Please request access if needed.

maria: Action list from leadership: 1) @sam: publish clarified external blurb about Optimize (ETA Fri). 2) @olivia: pilot outreach + intake form (ETA Wed). 3) @lee: post beta checklist & RFC link (ETA Thu). 4) @kevin: one-pager SLA FAQ for sales (ETA Fri). 5) @anish: collect any outstanding infra compatibility asks and DM @lee.

sarah: Can we get a short FAQ entry for the console changes announced? A few teams asked about webhook changes and token migration.

maria: @sarah please draft a 3-bullet FAQ for console webhook/token migration and drop it here; we'll add it to the all-hands digest.

olivia: I'll take point on pilot incentives and add a standard intro email template. Will post here once done.

lee: Beta checklist preview (short): onboarding contacts, sample pipelines, isv/partner license check, monitoring hooks, rollback plan. Full checklist to follow in confluence link.

kevin: Noted. I'll slot the SLA FAQ into Sales Confluence and ping leadership for a quick review.

maria: If anyone else has follow-ups from today's Q&A, drop them here. Closing this thread after all owners confirm they posted their artifacts. :white_check_mark:
